name: xhs-publisher
description: Automates Xiaohongshu (RED) video note publishing through a CDP-controlled real Chrome session: uploading, copy filling, originality and collection setup, draft or scheduled publishing, plus full-coverage reconciliation and troubleshooting for login, risk-control and draft-loss issues.
